scope: Manual pump-dock mesh-interface reviews, each bound to its identified publication/native inputs. Finite correspondence identifies inherited interfaces and does not accept their geometry, printability or load capacity. Classifier diagnoses apply only to exact emitted anchors/segments. No part generation, assembly graph write or recurring check.

rear_interface_native_correspondence.scope: Native finite-window correspondence between identified pre-pump-dock hardware and first-published pump dock. Baseline is the exact native input identified in cord-access-measurements.json; its post-C14 local equality is recorded there. Source ASTs for these interface producers and auxiliary files are compared separately. No physical acceptance or printability conclusion.

limits: The rear label/jack/anchor windows match pre-pump-dock native material after +7 mm Y; the handhold-floor thin window matches without translation. This is scope evidence only. Fine tube-anchor/keystone/handhold-floor sections, raised warning strokes and rear label/pad/roof support details remain unresolved outside this pump-dock change.

back_bottom_native_correspondence.scope: Manual finite-window native correspondence for actual first-published back-bottom top findings. The old native/source artifacts are bound by the frozen publication manifest. This distinguishes inherited local features from the pump-dock/depth changes; it establishes no acceptance of thin sections or markings. No canonical generation or graph write.

manual_checker_review.scope: Manual checker memory correction and completed reading of the exact published back-bottom STL. No permanent runner, recurring check, hook, scorecard row or build gate. All surface samples, distance reach, thickness bands and six defect classes are retained.

back_bottom_reading.memory_limit: The resident high-water reading excludes compressed/swapped memory; the separate footprint is an observed approximate value, not a measured process peak.

manual_checker_review.existing_selftest: passed at the recorded checker hash

bounded_clustering_reference.scope: Sparse, dense, multiband, separated, exact-radius, isolated, empty and singleton inputs; full output arrays are compared with the prior whole-graph algorithm and with that algorithm using the explicit deterministic tie rule.
bounded_clustering_reference.permitted_exception: In two fixtures, a thicker region touching multiple eligible roots of exactly equal least thickness is assigned to the root with the lowest original sample index instead of the undocumented cKDTree point-pair traversal order. Only the thicker rim ownership and its reported area/band can change. Root findings, anchors, thicknesses and the complete covered-sample multiset are retained.

bounded_memory_examples.scope: dense exact-radius connected component, new algorithm only
sparse component spanning multiple edge batches, exact old/new output

corrected_front_bottom_reading.scope: Full --all six-class reading of the corrected live front-bottom export. Every emitted row was reviewed. Cosmetics, actual material, invalid thickness segments and unresolved inherited interfaces have separate dispositions; an answer is not a physical acceptance.
corrected_front_bottom_reading.header_counting: The header states221 findings plus9 separately answered unranked rows. Ranked thin rows remain in place; one thin row carried an answer at run time. The complete emitted census is230 rows.

topology.scope: Read-only vertex-weld topology diagnosis. merge_vertices only identifies coincident STL vertices; no repair, sampling change or export.

corrected_front_bottom_reading.native_diagnostics_scope: All221 thin segments were classified at10/25/50/75/90percent. The source STEP is smooth before cosmetic fluting: its classification is used for rail/host/floor geometry and never as finished-flute thickness evidence. Native lines on a boundary are not through-material measurements.

mesh_diagnostics.scope: All221 emitted thin segments sampled at the same five positions in the exact fluted mesh, in batches of8queries. Unmerged STL topology initially reports false watertightness; coincident-vertex welding confirms closed manifold topology without changing triangles. Containment is diagnostic, not a strength or deposition result.

specific_cosmetic_flute_profile.limits: The coupon fixes the shared groove profile/depth/fade and the photographs establish appearance scope. The272-groove current field is not treated as inherited or physically accepted. Its exact new deposition, surface quality and load capacity remain unqualified. This exception is specific to the authored cosmetic contour, not a generic backed-stock waiver.

invalid_material_segments.limits: These invalid through-section diagnoses do not qualify other finite faces.

nominal_threshold_boundary.limits: Nominal and native common length3.000mm; classification at the floating3mm reach is not a smaller design section or a load result.

fitted_insert_annuli.limits: Dimensional host guidance only; installed insert retention, finger/compressor loads and vibration lifetime remain unqualified.

inherited_unresolved.limits: These actual sections remain unresolved outside the pump-dock implementation. Their answers identify scope, not acceptance or a strength/printability waiver.

retained_functional_ceilings.scope: Four screw-bearing ends, two handhold lifting faces and two rail catches retain their individual functional-interface/support-removal answers.

invalid_slope_locator.scope: Only the off-solid bounding-box locator is answered; the finite faces of the merged plane group are not qualified.

retained_interface_correspondence.scope: Native finite8mm cube correspondence of16 exact emitted condenser/MQ6/compressor-host segments against the frozen pre-pump-dock publication. These unchanged windows do not qualify strength or printability. Cosmetic flutes and new core stops are excluded.

immediate_pre_dock_scarf_construction.scope: Read-only finite scarf-nose construction from the actual unchanged source helpers and old/current authored Box inputs. This isolates the emitted Z−0.35 top and raked underside without rebuilding a quadrant. The corner movement affects the far upstream entry; both pocket plans fully cover this finite nose window. No material or load qualification.

corrected_front_bottom_reading.source_bindings_scope: Exact committed source bytes at identified corrected publication2203954ac; subsequent in-flight source changes do not rewrite this completed reading.
